newsitem.title: FRANCE: DHL regular line haul to absorb tunnel freight.
newsitem.headline: DHL regular line haul to absorb tunnel freight.

text.p: said its regular air cargo line-haul network would handle freight normally transported between the UK and the Continent by road via the Channel Tunnel.
The fixed rail link has been closed to traffic since Monday evening (November 18) following a fire in the tunnel.

"Tonight(Wednesday), as last night, we will be putting an extra Boeing 727F flight from London or Luton for road-borne freight which would have normally been transported to mainland Europe via the Tunnel," a Brussels- based DHL official told Reuters.
However, from tomorrow(Thursday) evening the extra flight will be withdrawn and "Tunnel" traffic will be accomdated by DHL's scheduled flights to and from the U.K., the official said.

On most evenings, DHL operated six nightly trucking ervices in each direction via the Tunnel linking its London distribution centre with Paris/CDG, Brussels and Breda in Holland - carrying "next-day before midday" and "before 10.30am" category shipments.

A Eurotunnel freight official told Reuters the Tunnel would be closed for an unspecified period and that customers would be kept informed on its re-opening. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
